Plot trait evolution through time

Source: R/plots.R
plotevoTrait.Rd

Plots the mean and standard deviation of selected traits through time for each species lineage.

Usage

plotevoTrait(
  object,
  SpIdx = NULL,
  Normalisation = FALSE,
  returnData = TRUE,
  traitID = NULL
)

Arguments

object

An object of class mizer::MizerSim.

SpIdx

Display a subset of species.

Normalisation

A boolean indicating whether to normalize the mean trait by initial trait value. Default is FALSE.

returnData

A boolean value that controls the output. Either a dataframe ready for ggplot (TRUE) or the plot itself (FALSE). Default is FALSE.

traitID

The trait column name to plot. Default is "w_mat".

Value

A ggplot object, or data list if returnData = TRUE.

See also

mizer::plotting_functions

Other plotting functions: plotDynamics(), plotPredMort(), plotPredRate(), plotSS(), plotSpawn(), plotStarvation(), plotevoFeeding(), plotevoGrowth(), plotevoMortality()

Examples

# \donttest{
params <- evoParams(no_sp = 5)
#> ℹ No `a` column so using a = 0.01 in w = a l^b, with w in g and l in cm.
#> ℹ No `b` column so using the isometric default b = 3 in w = a l^b.
#> ℹ Using f0, h, lambda, kappa and the predation kernel to calculate gamma.
#> Warning: Some column names in your species parameter data frame are very close to standard parameter names: `zeta` (did you mean `beta`?). Please check for mis-spellings.
sim <- evoProject(params, t_max = 20)
plotevoTrait(sim)
